title: Microflow: compact getting-started canvas for Hosted API (model select, request composer, code snippets)
creator: Linnea Berg
description: Design and deliver a compact, single-pane getting-started canvas focusing on model selection, a lightweight request composer, and copy-paste-ready code snippets. Goal is a 3-step microflow that fits into the docs quickstart and the product tour, optimized for small-screen capture and easy A/B testing against the existing starter tiles.
design_notes: Three visual states: compact (docs inline), expanded (console modal), hero (marketing tile). Start with compact for docs screenshot consistency.
Model selector shows name, short profile (latency/cost), and a small performance pill. Use softened card corners to match console theme.
Request composer is a single-line prompt input with optional structured-output toggle; show example with function/tool calling toggled off.
Include code snippets for curl, Python (requests), and Node (fetch). Ensure snippets are <=8 lines to remain legible in thumbnails.
Prefer light background for docs images and provide dark-mode variants for console screenshots. Export at 1920x1080 and a 1280x720 cropped thumbnail for the docs gallery.
Accessibility: ensure 4.5:1 contrast on interactive labels and use 14px minimum body text for screenshot fidelity.
Trade-off: to keep the canvas compact we omit advanced options (temperature, top_p) from primary view and surface them in an "advanced" flyout.
Model examples to show: redwood-2.7b (balanced), redwood-13b-quant (cost-savvy), open-llama-7b (community). These are illustrative and use anonymized latency numbers.
Include token/estimate meter in the corner of the request composer to demonstrate cost transparency.
Capture one example of streaming output (simulated) for the hero image but keep the docs flow static for reproducibility in tests.
acceptance_criteria: Deliver exported PNGs: compact-docs (1920x1080), console-modal (1920x1080), thumbnail (1280x720), and dark-mode variants
Attach copy-ready code snippets (curl, Python, Node) that paste into the quickstart docs without modification
Design reviewed and approved by PM (Diego Morales) and Eng owner (Samir Dutta)
Image exports added to Drive folder and linked from PRD; GH PR references the assets
A/B test variant (compact vs existing starter tiles) prepared with analytics hooks for click-through and time-to-first-request
